sign.speaker: Sign
sign.hello: Follow the path to the stone keep in the east. Watch out for slimes: they chase you!

elder.name: Old Turtle
elder.hello: Oh, what luck! Someone came. The slimes have taken over this forest.
elder.ask: Would you fetch the chest from the stone keep for me?
elder.tip: Press attack to swing the sword, dash to dodge. Slimes chase you the moment they see you, but they cannot pass walls.
elder.bye: Take your time. I'll wait right here.

toast.locked: The chest is locked: defeat all the slimes first
toast.hint: Open the chest in the keep

win.title: Chest opened!
win.text: The forest is at peace thanks to you.
